units.source_text: 對我而言，世間的確是一個深不可測的可怕之地，

en.t: To me, the world was indeed a fathomless and terrifying place,

units.source_text: 也絕非是靠「一決勝負」就可以輕易決定從何開始，從何結束的。

en.t: and it was certainly not so simple a place that one could settle where everything began and ended by a single contest.

units.source_text: 相互輕視，卻又彼此來往，而且彼此在交往中變得越來越無趣，

en.t: We despised each other, yet kept company with each other, and through that association each of us grew more and more dull,

units.source_text: 如果這就是世上所謂的「交友」狀態的話，

en.t: if this is what the world calls the state of friendship,

units.source_text: 那我和堀木的關係肯定就是「交友」的狀態。

en.t: then the relationship between Horiki and me was surely a state of friendship.

units.source_text: 憑著京橋小酒館老闆娘的俠義之心

en.t: Relying on the chivalrous kindness of the proprietress of the little bar in Kyobashi

units.source_text: （女人的俠義之心，這種說法本身就很奇怪，

en.t: although the very phrase chivalrous kindness in a woman is strange,

units.source_text: 就我的個人經驗而言，至少在都市的男女中，

en.t: in my personal experience, at least among men and women in the city,

units.source_text: 女人比男人更具有俠義之心。

en.t: women possessed more of that chivalrous kindness than men.
